scope: Four fixed intrusive capture-session diagnostics, two processes per role. Consistent event replay is not complete process allocation coverage, private-byte ownership, temporal phase alignment, causal allocator linkage or performance acceptance.
stackRule: Exact payload QPC/PID/TID one-to-one joins; full x64 stack tail bounded to192frames and cross-checked against TDH prefix/first32namedframes.
reallocRule: Successful immediately preceding same-numeric-TID Free of exact old heap/address/size plus unchanged directly observed destination Alloc generation, exact new heap/address/size/creator and joined stacks. Earlier dead address lifetimes and cross-thread old allocation are allowed. Summary leaves live bytes and original new allocation stack unchanged. Numeric TID generation and causal allocator linkage remain unproven.
categoryRule: Request-path categories use application-image stack RVAs resolved through the exact adjacent matching PDB. Only the32largest live stack groups per checkpoint are retained. Category bytes are partial, potentially overlapping request paths; they are not identified COM-object ownership or aligned steady-state measurements. Large graphics groups use a declared1MiBminimum.
moduleRule: Collector module point observations lack load/unload intervals. Their hash inventory is not bound by the original completion manifest; only its later digest is retained. Module attribution remains unverified.
observationRule: All original polls remain retained. Every query-begin checkpoint within inspected ETL bounds is replayed; pre/post-trace polls are counted. Point snapshots can include startup, pending/current generations and teardown. Do not average or select snapshots as final native phases.
acceptance: OPEN: no production optimization or primary performance gate is closed by this diagnostic.
